arxiv-2102-11381.title: Nonsmooth Quasistatic Modeling of Hydraulic Actuators
arxiv-2102-11381.creator: Ryo Kikuuwe, Tomofumi Okada, Hideo Yoshihara
arxiv-2102-11381.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ryo Kikuuwe, Tomofumi Okada, Hideo Yoshihara. This article presents a quasistatic model of a hydraulic actuator driven by a four-valve independent metering circuit. The presented model describes the quasistatic balance between the velocity and force and that between the flowrate and the pressure.

arxiv-2107-05781.title: Joule-Thomson expansion for noncommutative uncharged black holes
arxiv-2107-05781.creator: J. P. Morais Graça 1, Eduardo Folco Capossoli 2, Henrique Boschi-Filho 1
arxiv-2107-05781.description: Abstract In this work we study the Joule-Thomson expansion for uncharged black holes in a noncommutative scenario characterized by a parameter θ \theta , which is present in the horizon function. We calculate the inversion temperature for some values of θ \theta and the isenthalpics for fixed masses.

arxiv-2108-07627.creator: Amitoj Singh, Jingshu Chen, Lihao Zhang, Amin Rasekh, Ilana Golbin, Anand S. Rao
arxiv-2108-07627.description: Abstract . An independent ethical assessment of an artificial intelligence system is an impartial examination of the system’s development, deployment, and use in alignment with ethical values. System-level qualitative frameworks that describe high-level requirements and component-level quantitative metrics that measure individual ethical dimensions have been developed over the past few years.

arxiv-2310-11805.title: GMC-Pos: Graph-Based Multi-Robot Coverage Positioning Method
arxiv-2310-11805.creator: Khattiya Pongsirijinda, Zhiqiang Cao, Muhammad Shalihan, Benny Kai Kiat Ng, Billy Pik Lik Lau, Chau Yuen, U-Xuan Tan
arxiv-2310-11805.description: Abstract Nowadays, several real-world tasks require adequate environment coverage for maintaining communication between multiple robots, for example, target search tasks, environmental monitoring, and post-disaster rescues. In this study, we look into a situation where there are a human operator and multiple robots, and we assume that each human or robot covers a certain range of areas.

arxiv-2512-22890.title: Geometric decomposition of information flow for overdamped Langevin systems and optimal transport in subsystems
arxiv-2512-22890.creator: Sosuke Ito, Yoh Maekawa, Ryuna Nagayama, Andreas Dechant, Kohei Yoshimura
arxiv-2512-22890.description: Abstract Information flow between subsystems is a central concept in information thermodynamics, which provides the second-law-like inequalities for subsystems. This paper discusses the geometric decomposition of information flow, which was introduced for Markov jump systems [ Y Maekawa, R Nagayama, K Yoshimura and S Ito, arXiv:2509.21985 (2025) ], and applies it to overdamped Langevin systems.

pmc-10513277.title: Prevalence and influencing factors of probiotic usage among colorectal cancer patients in China: A national database study
pmc-10513277.creator: Difei Yao, Wei He, Yangmin Hu, Ying Yuan, Huimin Xu, Juan Wang, Haibin Dai
pmc-10513277.description: Probiotics have become increasingly popular among cancer patients. However, there is limited data from a real-world setting. This study aims to conduct a retrospective analysis to understand the trend of probiotic prescriptions in Chinese colorectal cancer patients. The Mann-Kendall and Cochran-Armitage trend test was applied to estimate the trend significance. Gephi software identified the combination of probiotic strains.

pmc-10578177.creator: Intissar Haddiya, Siria Valoti
pmc-10578177.description: Beta-blockers include a large spectrum of drugs with various specific characteristics, and a well-known cardioprotective efficacy. They are recommended in heart failure, hypertension and arrhythmia. Their use in chronic hemodialysis patients is still controversial, mainly because of the lack of specific randomized clinical trials.

pmc-11659345.title: Application of waste iron in wet flue gas desulfurization (WFGD) wastewater treatment
pmc-11659345.creator: Dominika Ścieżyńska, Maciej Majewski, Susmita Nath, Dominika Bury, Agnieszka Jastrzębska, Jan Bogacki, Piotr Marcinowski
pmc-11659345.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The wet flue gas desulfurization (WFGD) procedure results in wastewater containing a complex mixture of pollutants, including heavy metals and organic compounds, which are hardly degradable and pose significant environmental challenges. Addressing this issue, the proposed approach, incorporating waste iron shavings as a heterocatalyst within a modified Fenton process, represents a sustainable and effective solution for contaminants degrading in WFGD wastewater.

pmc-12399518.title: Case Report: Concurrent retinal vasculitis and optic neuritis in systemic lupus erythematosus
pmc-12399518.creator: Di Jin, Xun Liu, Yuwei Wang, Longjiang Fang, Weiduo Nie, Chen Li, Sheng-Guang Li, Ming Li
pmc-12399518.description: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a multisystem autoimmune disease that can affect the ocular system, with retinal vasculitis and optic neuritis being rare but serious manifestations. We present a case of a 26-year-old female with newly diagnosed SLE who developed both retinal vasculitis and optic neuritis, leading to progressive visual impairment.

pmc-12452297.title: Cellular Delivery of Functional AntimiR Conjugated to Bio-Produced Gold Nanoparticles
pmc-12452297.creator: Parastoo Pourali, Veronika Benson, Francisco J Enguita
pmc-12452297.description: Background/Objectives: Bio-produced gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) are effective carriers of short RNAs into specialized mammalian cells. Their potential application is still limited by scarce knowledge on their uptake and intracellular fate. Gold nanoparticles that are not biologically produced (NB-AuNPs) enter specialized cells primarily via clathrin-dependent endocytosis.

pmc-12986776.title: The Performance of Artificial Intelligence in Classifying Molecular Markers in Adult-Type Gliomas Using Histopathological Images: Systematic Review
pmc-12986776.creator: Obada Almaabreh, Rukaya Al-Dafi, Aliya Tabassum, Ahmad Othman, Alaa Abd-alrazaq
pmc-12986776.description: BackgroundAdult-type gliomas are among the most prevalent and lethal primary central nervous system tumors, where prompt and accurate diagnosis is essential for maximizing survival prospects. Molecular classification, particularly the detection of isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) mutations and 1p/19q codeletions, has become crucial for accurate diagnosis and prognosis.

pmc-13146108.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1101 DISSOCIATION BETWEEN PROCESSING SPEED AND NEUROIMAGING BURDEN ACROSS CEREBRAL SMALL VESSEL DISEASE ETIOLOGIES
pmc-13146108.creator: Gemma Solé-Guardia, Jessica Lebenberg, Ivy Uszynski, Cyril Poupon, Anil Tuladhar, Eric Jouvent
pmc-13146108.description: Background and aimsCerebral small vessel disease (SVD) contributes to stroke and cognitive decline and is identified by neuroimaging markers. However, clinical and radiological presentation varies widely between SVD etiologies, complicating the associations between neuroimaging markers and cognitive function. Processing speed is often impaired in individuals with SVD, but its relationship with neuroimaging markers of SVD remains poorly understood.

pmc-13262914.title: Low-molecular-weight peptides from deer antler velvet: Antioxidant potential, biosafety, and synergistic interaction with nanomelanin
pmc-13262914.creator: Nguyen Dinh Thang, Pham Hai Long, Nguyen Thu Uyen, Tran Hoang Thuy Duong, Ngo Thi Trang, Le Thi Hong Nhung, Nguyen Lai Thanh, Nguyen Thi Bich Loan, Pham Thi Luong Hang, Vu Van In, Vu Minh Hung, Jung-Hyun Lee, Min-Sik Kim
pmc-13262914.description: Deer antler velvet (DAV) is a precious pharmaceutical source. Low-molecular-weight peptides (LMWPs) extracted from DAV have been reported as promising pharmaceutical ingredients with various potential applications across different health care areas. Components, molecular weights, and bioactivities of DAV’s peptides may vary depending on the production protocols.
